settings.detectedDescription: ** Do not share this information publicly **
settings.confirmSend:
Send the log contents to the developer?
** All identifiers will be removed **
settings.logSendFailed:
Failed to send after 5 attempts.
The error messages are at the end of the log.
settings.enableLogExplanation:
If enabled, the app will log a lot of diagnostics information.
The app will still log errors even if this is disabled.
settings.useHomeyBrokerExplanation: Enable this to run the app's local MQTT broker on Homey. Disable it if you want to use an external broker or another broker running on Homey instead.
settings.brokerURLExplanation: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker. For the built-in broker this is usually localhost.
settings.brokerPortExplanation: MQTT TCP port used by the broker connection.
settings.brokerWSPortExplanation: MQTT WebSocket port used by clients that connect over WebSocket.
settings.usernameExplanation: Username used when connecting to the selected MQTT broker.
settings.passwordExplanation: Password used when connecting to the selected MQTT broker.
settings.showPasswordExplanation: Temporarily show the password text while editing this field.
settings.emailExplanation: If you want me to respond to your log, please enter your email address or forum id here so I know how to contact you.
settings.descriptionExplanation: Please enter a brief description of the problem if you are going to send the log.
settings.sendLogConfirm: Send the log contents to the developer?
settings.intro: The app has a built-in MQTT broker that can be used, or you can select an external broker.
settings.broker_warning_port_in_use: Built-in MQTT broker could not start because broker port is already in use:
settings.broker_warning_wsport_in_use: Built-in MQTT WebSocket listener could not start because the WebSocket port is already in use:
settings.mqttSetupReminder: Make sure you add the device in the LinknLink mobile app and configure the device MQTT service with the same details as this app.
